table: SC-1500-C022是7.4V15.6KG串口总线舵机，采用塑胶外壳，金属齿轮箱、铁芯电机、飞特自主研发的TTL控制板，高品质电位器，25T型输出头。堵转扭矩15.6kg.cm，有效控制角度为180°，具有伺服模式和连续转电机工作模式，反馈位置、速度、电压、温度、负载参数，从而实现过载保护。适合应用于教学、创客、机器人关节等小扭力传动应用场景。 SCS15-C022 is 7.4V15.6kg serial bus servo，adopt plastic case，metal gearbox、core motor, Feetech self researched and developed TTL control board，high quality potentiometer, 25T output shaft. The stall torque is 15.6kg.cm, effective control angle is 180 °, with servo mode and continuous motor working mode, feedback position, speed, voltage, temperature, load parameters, so as to achieve overload protection. It is suitable for teaching, maker, robot joints and other small torque transmission applications.
